obligation: Synthetic Company obligation: every hosted web workload applies the reference application baseline before release.

requirements.statement: Synthetic baseline: web endpoints accept only HTTPS with TLS 1.2 or later.
Synthetic baseline: web endpoints send diagnostic logs to a central workspace.
Synthetic baseline: private workloads disable public network access and use private endpoints.
Synthetic baseline: private workloads admit only authenticated or privately routed requests.
Synthetic baseline: content stores disable shared-key administrative access.
Synthetic baseline: virtual networks enable DDoS Network Protection with an associated protection plan, refining NIST SP 800-53 SC-5 denial-of-service protection.
Synthetic baseline: high-criticality workloads rotate vault secrets automatically.
